boundary: These are operational evidence tests for deriving a domain candidate. They do not redefine the canonical P1/P2/P3 domain names or book ownership.

domains.evidenceTest: Evidence must directly support formation, initialization, activation, establishment, or structural coming-into-being; a current state or date alone is insufficient.

Evidence must directly support ongoing operation, routing, functioning, coordination, load, exchange, or active runtime relationships in an already operating system; currentness alone is insufficient.
Evidence must directly support persistence, maintenance, recovery, calibration, governance, adaptation across time, or continuity of an established system; longevity alone is insufficient.
